nodes.text: OBJECTION 1 — "each moment you are actively taking yourself out of a

the owner's line is poetically right and mechanism-
correct at the level the video operates. The bridge text after it
should name the five hindrances as the "you" — otherwise a viewer
thinks it's mystical.

does naming the hindrances make it sound like
"just don't have desire" (the prescriptive trap)? The video must not
preach — the blank-screen beat is the teaching, not the explanation.

---
OBJECTION 2 — the blank screen: is 20 seconds too long or not long

keep 20 seconds. The DIR card already notes the chapter
marker. But: check the YouTube chapter timestamp matches (CH.3 starts
at 4:00 — chapter marker must read exactly 4:00, no drift).

mobile viewers may close the app during 20s of
black. Acceptable — the debrief catches them when they scrub back.

---
OBJECTION 3 — "Ajahn Brahm is having terrible sex" — is this a

two options: (a) find the clip — Brahm talks are widely
published, check if the specific line is in a freely-licensed talk;
(b) if not clearable, use a paraphrase card attributed to Brahm with
the source citation — but this weakens the beat because the whole point
is hearing HIM say it.

clearance is the blocker, not the writing. Mark
as CONTINGENT — if clip fails, the beat reverts to CH.6 definitions
with the "real phenomenon" bridge carrying the weight.

---
OBJECTION 4 — "use cases in rehab" — the owner flagged this "bit

cut it or mark [DRAFT — owner to voice]. Never leave
an unsourced claim in a script that's otherwise citation-locked.

the owner's "bit shaky here lol" IS the honesty —
the line works as self-aware hedging if delivered as-is with a laugh.

---
OBJECTION 5 — "it is the natural state of the mind" — Nyanamoli's

the script structure is correct: definition → immediate
pushback → phenomenological discovery. The definition is intentionally
unsatisfying; the unsatisfying-ness IS the bridge to the deeper
question (why aren't people in ecstasy?).

we don't have the actual Nyanamoli book passages
banked yet (ACQUIRE #2). Until then, the READ uses HH 38hh/284hh
extracts as stand-ins. Must swap before synth.

---
OBJECTION 6 — the "8 jhanas" question gets deferred (CH.7) — is

correct to defer. But CH.7 must PROMISE it: "the 8
jhana, mapped" end card = the hook for the next video (or the shamatha
video which already has the Vism stages).

if the owner wants it IN this video (his brief
mentions it early), move one 8-jhana card into CH.6 after definitions.
